meta.title: Pricing — Mobilcab
meta.description: Now: free app + Founding Partner waitlist. At M2: paid Basic with an FP discount; later, full list price. AI plans announced separately.

hero.label: Pricing
hero.title: Free now. FP discount at M2. Then list price.
hero.body: Use the app for free. If you want a discount on Basic when we ship M2, join the Founding Partner waitlist. Anyone who subscribes later, without a waitlist place, pays full list. The figures below are indicative until paid launch.

callout.title: New here?
callout.body: Founding Partner means a free waitlist sign-up now and a discount on Basic when we open payment with M2 — with no obligation. Anyone who comes later pays list price.

fpYearly: Founding Partner: discount on Basic at M2 (amounts at paid launch)
cancel: No contract — cancel anytime (once subscriptions exist)
aiTrial: AI assistant: one trial, during onboarding
aiPerMonth: AI assistant: {count} requests per month (future plans)

free.name: Free
free.for: To use Mobilcab on your own projects until we open paid plans.

basic.name: Basic
basic.for: At paid launch with M2: design, cut lists, sheet nesting, labels and quotes — no CNC and no recurring AI. FP waitlist: discount; later: list price.
features: No CNC export in this plan

starter.name: Starter
starter.for: Later: for workshops that want the AI assistant on everyday projects.

pro.name: Pro
pro.for: Later: for workshops with many projects a month.

studio.name: Studio
studio.for: Later: for workshops that use the AI assistant on every project.

why.title: Why is AI separate?
why.body: Basic is built for the workshop (design through to a quote). The AI assistant costs per request, so it comes in separate plans when the time is right — not as a blocker for Basic.

note: We don't charge subscriptions until paid Basic opens with M2. Table prices are indicative. The FP discount is only for people on the Founding Partner waitlist.
